Scenario OAT-02/S14 — The sign-in code email is the only email the code can send, and its template carries no patient data

Requirements it checks:
- U4: No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. The Settings 'Contact support' mailto with no subject or body carries no patient data and is allowed.

Given: convex/ at the UAT commit
When: List every sendEmail call site and read the sign-in code template and its inputs.
Then: Exactly two call sites: convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40 (deliverSignInOtp, input {email, otp, type}) and convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21 (sendResetPassword), which is disabled because emailOtpAuthOptions spreads after it in convex/auth.ts (email and password off, reset paths in disabledPaths). The template is subject 'Your Round Companion sign-in code' and a body with the code, the 5-minute expiry line and the 'If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.' line. Delivery is S22.
Oracle: UAT OAT-02 step 3 'nothing PHI-bearing exits through an unencrypted channel … (no email, in app only)'. Code, expiry and ignore line only; no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. A third call site, a template input beyond {email, otp, type}, or the reset path enabled = Fail. That a code-only email is acceptable is Q9.

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

List every sendEmail (or other email-sending) call site in apps/web/convex and read the sign-in code email template and its inputs. Check convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts (deliverSignInOtp), convex/auth_provider_extension.ts (sendResetPassword) and convex/auth.ts (whether email+password is off, reset paths are in disabledPaths, and emailOtpAuthOptions is spread after the extension).

pass = exactly the sign-in code path (inputs {email, otp, type}) plus the reset-password hook that is disabled, and the template carries only the code, the 5-minute expiry line and the ignore line (no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link)
fail = a third call site, a template input beyond {email, otp, type}, a patient field or link in the email, or the reset path enabled
